fieldValues.title: What should srs-web show a person who opens a repository?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised 2026-10-30 after the four readable repositories were opened in srs-web and the owner said: "I cannot understand them at all. It may just be that the three column layout is not the right starting point."
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. A reading view first: one column, full width. It opens on the identity record's guide; a section opens as its overview document followed by its children in outline order (title and first line each); breadcrumbs above; drilling down is clicking. The three-column editor is one switch away.
- B. Keep the three columns, but a section shows its anchor document above the ordered outline instead of search results, and the inspector stays closed until asked for.
- C. Document first: open the repository's front-door composition full width, with the navigation as a collapsible table of contents; records open in place.
- D. Lenses as the start: a set, one thing, what links to it (remedy 364126da), with the reading view as one lens.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions:
Which one a newcomer understands in the first minute, tested with the owner and a cold reader on the same four repositories. Whether A needs anything from the engine beyond the container outline and anchor records it already exposes (likely not). How each behaves for a repository that has not been structured (a data dump): the view must degrade to something sensible.

The positive case (owner, 2026-10-30: "srs-context is actually really readable"). In the same shell, srs-context opens on agent-brief, a composition that renders its brief as prose; its few layers are numbered in reading order (00 Brief to 99 Dogfood) and each is small; every record type has a reading card, so records read as text, not as label and value rows. What it shares with option C: the first thing seen is a written document, not a list. The test of any option is whether the other repositories read as srs-context does.
fieldValues.next_action: Mock A and C over the four repositories as static pages (rendered from the CLI outline), put them in front of the owner beside today's screens, and pick one to prototype in srs-web.
